paite: Judah khelhna sik laigelhna leh suangmantam hiam mukzum a gelh ahi; alungtang pek ua khuak in a-om a, amaitam uahte leng;
heading: Judah Khelhna Leh Gawtna
english: The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond: it is engraved on the tablet of their heart, and on the horns of your altars;

paite: sing hing bul leh mual pawngte ah atate un amaitamte uleh a Asherahte uh atheigige ngal ua.
english: while their children remember their altars and their Asherim by the green trees on the high hills.

paite: Aw nang gam a ka tang, gam dung tawn a na khelhna ziak in na sum leh na gou tengteng, na mun sangte toh gallak ding in ka pe ding hi.
english: My mountain in the field, I will give your substance and all your treasures for a spoil, and your high places, because of sin, throughout all your borders.

paite: Huai na tantuam ka hon piak na tan ding a, na gam theih ngeih louh ah na melmate nna ka hon semsak ding, ka hehna mei, tangtawn a kang ding lah na mut kuangta ngal ua.
english: You, even of yourself, shall discontinue from your heritage that I gave you; and I will cause you to serve your enemies in the land which you don’t know: for you have kindled a fire in my anger which shall burn forever.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Mihing muang a, mihing bantha hatna muang a, TOUPA lehngatsan lungtang neimi hamsethuak in om hen.
english: Thus says Yahweh: Cursed is the man who trusts in man, and makes flesh his arm, and whose heart departs from Yahweh.

paite: Gamdai a loupa keu gaw bang ahi a, thil hoih pawt ding amu kei ding. Gamdai gamkeu, chi gam, kuamah luah louh ah ateng zaw ding hi.
english: For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good comes, but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, a salt land and not inhabited.

paite: TOUPA muangmi, alametpen TOUPA hi in nuam asa hi.
english: Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose trust Yahweh is.

paite: Tui kiang a sing suan, lui gei a zungkai, kholum hong tung ding patau lou, anahte hing gige, khokhen kum khawk sa lou, gah suan kikhelsak tuan lou bang ahi ding hi.
english: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and shall not fear when heat comes, but its leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.

paite: Lungtang bel thil tengteng sang in khemhat pen, hoih lou pumlum ahi a; kua'n ahia theithei ding?
english: The heart is deceitful above all things, and it is exceedingly corrupt: who can know it?

paite: Kei TOUPA bel michih a-omdan bang zel uleh athilhih gah bang zel a pe ding a lungsim enkhepa, lungtang enchianpa ka hi.
english: I, Yahweh, search the mind, I try the heart, even to give every man according to his ways, according to the fruit of his doings.

paite: Mi, kilawm lou a hong hau bel vengkeng, ama tuiloupi keuhsak dia op bang ahi, adam lai ngei in amah atuansan ding ua, atawp in mihai ahong himai ding.
english: As the partridge that sits on eggs which she has not laid, so is he who gets riches, and not by right; in the midst of his days they shall leave him, and at his end he shall be a fool.

paite: Ka mun siangthou omna bel laltutphah thupi mahmah, atung a kipan a tawisang a om ahi.
english: A glorious throne, set on high from the beginning, is the place of our sanctuary.

paite: Aw TOUPA Israel lamet, nang hon paisan mi tengteng azahlak ding uh; kei hon lehngatsan mite lei a leivui a gelh bang lel ahi ding uh, TOUPA hinna tuikhuk pen lah apaisanta ngal ua.
english: Yahweh, the hope of Israel, all who forsake you shall be disappointed. Those who depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken Yahweh, the spring of living waters.

paite: Aw TOUPA hon hihdam inla, huchi in ka dam ding a, hon humbit lechin, huchi in ka bit ding, ka phat gige nang na hi.
heading: Jeremiah In TOUPA Panpihna Angen
english: Heal me, O Yahweh, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for you are my praise.

paite: "Ngai in, ka kiang ah, TOUPA thu koi ah? Hong tung leh ake," achi sek uh.
english: Behold, they tell me, Where is the word of Yahweh? let it come now.

paite: Thil hoih lou tungsak ding ka hon phut kei a, siatna ni lah ka deih het kei chih na thei hi; ka kam a thupawt lah na maima a om ahi ngal a.
english: As for me, I have not hurried from being a shepherd after you; neither have I desired the woeful day; you know: that which came out of my lips was before your face.

paite: Kei a ding in kihtakhuai hi ke'nla, mangbat ni a ka kihumbitna na hi.
english: Don’t be a terror to me: you are my refuge in the day of evil.

paite: Hon simmohte zahlak uhenla, kei bel zahlak kei leng; amau bel lungzing uhenla, kei bel lungzing kei leng; mangbat ni atung uah tun inla, nakpi in amaute hihmang in.
english: Let them be disappointed who persecute me, but let not me be disappointed; let them be dismayed, but don’t let me be dismayed; bring on them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi: Kuan inla, Judah kumpipate lutna zel leh pawtna zel, mipite tate kongpi ah leh Jerusalem kongpite tengteng ah va dingh inla;
heading: Sabbath Tan Thu
english: Thus said Yahweh to me: Go, and stand in the gate of the children of the people, through which the kings of Judah come in, and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;

paite: akiang uah, "Nou Judah kumpipate, Judah tengtengte, Jerusalem a teng tengteng hiai kongpi a lut sekte aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia un."
english: and tell them, Hear the word of Yahweh, you kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Na hinna uh pilvang mahmah dih ua, Sabbath ni in puak nei kei unla, Jerusalem kulh kongpi ah lutpih sam kei un.
english: Thus says Yahweh, Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the Sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem;

paite: Huan Sabbath ni in na inn ua kipan puak na pokhe ding uh ahi kei a, nna na sem ding uh ahi sam kei; na pipute uh kiang a ka thupiak bang in Sabbath na tang siangthou zaw ding uh ahi.
english: neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the Sabbath day holy, neither do any work: but make the Sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.

paite: Amau zaw angaikhe kei ua, bil adoh kei ua; thununna azak ua atanlouhna ding un akigenhaksak zaw uhi."
english: But they didn’t listen, neither turn their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, and might not receive instruction.

paite: TOUPA thupawt in hichi in achi: "Khawksatak a na hon ngaihkhiak ua, Sabbath ni a hiai khopi a kongpi a thil na puaklut louh ua,
english: It shall happen, if you diligently listen to me, says Yahweh, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, but to make the Sabbath day holy, to do no work therein;

paite: nna na sep louh ua Sabbath na tan siangthou uleh, hiai khopi kongpi ah leh heutute, David tutphah a tu dingte kangtalaite leh sakolte ah tuang in ahong lut ding ua, amau leh amiliante uh Judah leh Jerusalem a tengte toh; huchi in hiai khopi ah mi atengdenta ding uh.
english: then shall there enter in by the gates of this city kings and princes sitting on the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and this city shall remain forever.

paite: Judah khopi leh Jerusalem kim a kipan, Benjamin gam a kipan, gam niam gam a kipan, tanggam a kipan leh Sim gam a kipan in ahong pai ding ua, halmang thillat leh kithoihnate buh-le-bal thillat leh gimlimte, kipahna kithoihnate TOUPA inn ah ahon tawi ding uh.
english: They shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places around Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the lowland, and from the hill country, and from the South, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and meal offerings, and frankincense, and bringing sacrifices of thanksgiving, to the house of Yahweh.

paite: Himahleh Sabbath tang siangthou ding leh Sabbath ni a puak neih louh leh Jerusalem kulh kongpi a lutpih louh ding thu ah na hon ngaihkhiak kei uleh akulh kongpite ah mei ka pawtsak ding a, Jerusalem kumpipa' inn te akangbei ding a, amit kei ding hi."
english: But if you will not listen to me to make the Sabbath day holy, and not to bear a burden and enter in at the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in its gates, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.
